cues.en: Instructor: The summation notation is super important in statistics.
cues.zh: 加總記號在統計中非常重要。

cues.en: You will see this notation all over the place in statistics, certainly in this course.
cues.zh: 統計中到處都會看到這種記號，本課程當然也是。

cues.en: So if you are not already comfortable with the summation sign, then definitely put your thinking cap on for this video.
cues.zh: 如果還不熟悉加總符號，這部影片一定要專心思考。

cues.en: Okay, so let's start with a set of numbers, we'll call this set a.
cues.zh: 先從一組數字開始，稱這個集合為 a。

cues.en: And it's just this list of five numbers.
cues.zh: 它就是這五個數組成的清單。

cues.en: So we can ask, what is the sum of all the numbers in this set?
cues.zh: 可以問，這個集合中所有數的總和是多少？

cues.en: Well, that's pretty trivial to compute, it's just one plus three plus four plus one plus six.
And according to my genius mathematical computations, that equals 15.
cues.zh: 根據我天才般的數學計算，結果是 15。

cues.en: You can break out your super fancy calculator and confirm that I've gotten the right solution.
cues.zh: 可以拿出你超高級的計算機，確認我算對了。

cues.en: Anyway, so this is fine for this little problem, but what if we had a larger number of numbers?
cues.zh: 這個小問題這樣做沒問題，但如果數字的數量更多呢？

cues.en: Or what if we don't even know exactly how many numbers?
cues.zh: 或者，根本不知道到底有多少個數？

cues.en: Or maybe it doesn't matter exactly what these numbers are, we want to express the sum of all the elements in this set.
cues.zh: 又或者，這些數字確切是多少並不重要，只想表示集合中所有元素的總和。

cues.en: Well, we could also write it out this way.
cues.zh: 也能寫成這個樣子。

cues.en: So you have a subscript one plus a subscript two.
cues.zh: 就是 a 下標 1，加 a 下標 2。

cues.en: So the subscripts would be indicating the indices.
cues.zh: 下標表示索引。

cues.en: So this is the first element of a, this is the second element of a, which is the number of three.
cues.zh: 所以這是 a 的第一個元素，這是第二個元素，也就是數字 3。

cues.en: And then you have this dot, dot, dot, this ellipsis, this indicates in math that there's a bunch of stuff missing in here that we're now printing out, up to the nth element of a.
cues.zh: 接著這三個點，也就是省略號，在數學上表示中間省略了一些沒有列印出來的內容，一直到 a 的第 n 個元素。

cues.en: Now, this is a slightly better way to write out the summation compared to this, because here we don't need to know, or I should say, this expression generalizes
cues.zh: 這比前面那種寫法稍微好一點，因為這裡不需要知道，或者應該說，這個算式能推廣到，

cues.en: to any number of elements in a, so however long a is, and it also doesn't matter exactly what the elements are.
cues.zh: a 有任意數量元素的情況，不論 a 多長，也不在乎元素具體是多少。

cues.en: And we can get even better than this, we can write even better, more compact notation.
cues.zh: 還能更好，可以寫成更精簡的記號。

cues.en: And that is this summation notation.
cues.zh: 也就是這個加總記號。

cues.en: So it's this big E looking thing, it's actually the Greek capital letter sigma.
cues.zh: 這個很像大寫 E 的符號，其實是希臘字母大寫 Sigma。

cues.en: And this indicates a summation.
cues.zh: 它表示加總。

cues.en: So the way that you read this expression here is actually a little bit like a for loop in computer code.
cues.zh: 讀這個算式的方式，其實有點像程式中的 for 迴圈。

cues.en: So you say for i equals one until i equals n.
cues.zh: 從 i 等於 1，直到 i 等於 n。

cues.en: So basically we're looping through indices, this would be the ith index, from the first index up to the nth index of a.
cues.zh: 基本上就是走訪索引，這是第 i 個索引，從 a 的第一個索引到第 n 個索引。

cues.en: And then what do we do?
cues.zh: 接著做什麼？

cues.en: We just sum all of the elements of a.
cues.zh: 把 a 的所有元素加總。

cues.en: So this compact notation is the same thing as this.
cues.zh: 所以這個精簡記號，和這個是同一回事。

cues.en: And for this specific example, this notation is also the same thing as this expression here on the left side of this equation.
cues.zh: 而在這個特定例子中，這個記號，也和等號左邊的算式相同。

cues.en: So you can see this is a really compact and handy way of writing out the summation of all the elements in some vector or some set of numbers.
cues.zh: 可見這是表示向量或一組數字中，所有元素總和的精簡方便方式。

cues.en: And of course, this can be more complicated, maybe it's the, you know, a times the ith index of a times the ith index of b plus 47 to the power of pi,
cues.zh: 當然也能更複雜，也許是 a，乘上 a 的第 i 個元素，再乘 b 的第 i 個元素，加上 47 的 π 次方，

cues.en: I don't know, whatever.
cues.zh: 隨便舉個例子。

cues.en: You can have more complicated expressions inside this summation.
cues.zh: 加總記號裡面，可以放更複雜的算式。

cues.en: The last thing I wanna point out here is sometimes you will also see this expression without any of the subscript or superscript here.
cues.zh: 最後要指出，有時也會看到這種寫法，沒有任何下標或上標。

cues.en: And when you see it like this, then well, you know, technically there's information that's missing and you just have to do a little bit of guesswork to try and figure out
cues.zh: 看到這種情況，技術上確實少了資訊，只能稍微推測，

cues.en: what is the appropriate range of indexing here?
cues.zh: 索引適當的範圍是什麼。

cues.en: And if it's not indicated, then you can generally assume that the index goes from one to n.
cues.zh: 如果沒寫，通常可以假設索引從 1 到 n。

cues.en: So from the first element in the set up to the last element in the set.
cues.zh: 也就是從集合的第一個元素，到最後一個元素。

cues.en: This notation is usually used when there isn't a lot of space in the equation.
cues.zh: 這種記法通常用在方程式空間不多時。

cues.en: So then they will just leave these things under the assumption that you know what they are referring to.
cues.zh: 於是省略這些資訊，假設你知道他們指的是什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so in this video, I covered the summation notation.
cues.zh: 這部影片介紹了加總記號。

cues.en: If that was new information for you, then please take a moment to study it and make sure you understand it.
cues.zh: 如果這對你是新資訊，請花點時間研究，確保理解。

cues.en: It's going to come up very, very often throughout this course.
cues.zh: 整門課會非常頻繁地出現。
